name: syncEHRData
shortDescription: Synchronizes patient and medical record data with an external EHR system using RESTful/FHIR APIs.
description:
Overview

This function integrates with an external Electronic Health Record (EHR) system to synchronize patient and medical record data. It supports data exchange using RESTful and FHIR-based APIs to maintain consistency across systems.

Intended use

Invoked as an event handler, typically after an Appointment or MedicalRecord is created or updated within the HMP. It ensures that changes in HMP are reflected in the EHR system.

Logic

  1. Receive event data containing details of the changed Patient, MedicalRecord, or Appointment.
  2. Transform the HMP data structure into the format required by the external EHR system (e.g., FHIR resources).
  3. Make an authenticated API call to the EHRSystem using ctx.service('EHRSystem') to create or update the corresponding records.
  4. Handle potential API errors and log the synchronization attempt and its outcome using ctx.audit.log.
  5. Return a success or failure status.

Entities

  • Patient
  • MedicalRecord
  • Appointment
  • AuditLog

External Services

  • EHRSystem
